links.outcome: Faithfulness of LLM explanations under varied few-shot, prompting, and training settings on BBQ and MedQA
links.effect: Faithfulness varied significantly with number and quality of few-shot examples and with prompt design; instruction tuning improved measured faithfulness on MedQA.
links.quote: Our results show: (i) both the quantity and quality of few-shot examples significantly impact model faithfulness; (ii) faithfulness is sensitive to prompting design; (iii) the instruction-tuning phase improves measured faithfulness on MedQA.

screen.reason: Empirically assesses how deployment choices such as few-shot exemplar selection and prompt design impact explanation faithfulness in medical question answering (MedQA).
